message.content:
**Short answer:**  
Yes – you can file a noise complaint in Atlanta, but it’s not the city council that handles it directly. The complaint is routed to the city’s **Code Enforcement** or **Police Department** (or the “Noise Ordinance” division). The city council can review the complaint if you bring it to them, but the first stop is the city’s official complaint system.

---

## How to File a Noise Complaint in Atlanta

| Step | What to Do | Where to Go / Who to Call |
|------|------------|---------------------------|
| 1 | **Check the Noise Ordinance** – Know what constitutes “excessive noise” (e.g., loud music after 10 p.m., construction noise, barking dogs, etc.). | <https://www.atlantaga.gov/government/departments/department-of-public-safety/department-of-public-safety-division-of-traffic-and-transportation/noise-ordinance> |
| 2 | **File Online** – Use the city’s “Noise Complaint” portal. | <https://www.atlantaga.gov/government/departments/department-of-public-safety/department-of-public-safety-division-of-traffic-and-transportation/noise-complaint> |
| 3 | **Call 311** – If you prefer phone or need help filling out the form. | 311 (or 404‑656‑3111) |
| 4 | **Email or Fax** – For written records or if you’re unable to use the online form. | Email: noise@atlantaga.gov (check the website for the current address) |
| 5 | **Visit City Hall** – If you want to speak in person or need a paper copy of the complaint. | 1000 Peachtree Street NW, Atlanta, GA 30303 |
| 6 | **Contact Your Council Member** – If you want the council to take a closer look or if the issue is persistent. | Find your council member: <https://www.atlantaga.gov/government/city-council/council-member-contact> |

### Quick Contact Details

| Department | Phone | Email | Website |
|------------|-------|-------|---------|
| **Atlanta Police Department – Noise Division** | 404‑656‑3111 (311) | noise@atlantaga.gov | <https://www.atlantapd.org> |
| **City of Atlanta Code Enforcement** | 404‑656‑3111 (311) | code@atlantaga.gov | <https://www.atlantaga.gov/government/departments/department-of-public-safety/department-of-public-safety-division-of-traffic-and-transportation> |
| **City Council (General)** | 404‑656‑3111 (311) | council@atlantaga.gov | <https://www.atlantaga.gov/government/city-council> |

---

## What Happens After You File

1. **Acknowledgment** – You’ll receive a confirmation (email or phone) that the complaint was received.
2. **Investigation** – A city officer will visit the location, check the noise level, and determine if it violates the ordinance.
3. **Action** – If a violation is found, the officer may issue a warning, a citation, or refer the matter to the court.
4. **Follow‑up** – You can track the status of your complaint through the online portal or by calling 311.

---

## Tips for a Successful Complaint

- **Be Specific** – Include the exact address, time, date, and description of the noise.
- **Provide Evidence** – If possible, attach a short audio clip or a photo of the source (e.g., a construction site).
- **Keep Records** – Save copies of any emails, screenshots, or notes from phone calls.
- **Follow Up** – If you haven’t heard back in 7–10 business days, call 311 or email the department.

---

### Bottom Line

You can definitely report a noise issue in Atlanta. Use the city’s online portal or call 311 to file the complaint. The city council can be involved if you want them to take a closer look, but the primary handling authority is the city’s Code Enforcement or Police Department.
